questions.skill: Use the properties of exponents to transform exponential expressions
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: An account grows by 6% each year: A = 500(1.06)^t after t years. Rewrite the expression to show the monthly growth factor, rounded to four decimal places.
questions.prompt_markup:
An account grows by 6% each year: A = 500(1.06)^t after t years.
Rewrite the expression to show the monthly growth factor, rounded to four decimal places.
questions.grading_note: Form required: 500 times (monthly factor)^(12t). The factor is 1.06^(1/12) ≈ 1.0049, so A = 500(1.06^(1/12))^(12t).
